node.statement: Raw compression operators amplify exactly: for a linear operator T:A->A put iota_n(T)([X_ij])=[T(X_ij)]. With B_{P,Q}=L_P R_Q+R_Q L_P-1_A, where (L_P R_Q)(X)=P(XQ) and (R_Q L_P)(X)=(PX)Q as in def-compressed-corner, direct entrywise multiplication gives L_{P_n}R_{Q_n}=iota_n(L_P R_Q), R_{Q_n}L_{P_n}=iota_n(R_Q L_P), and 1_{M_n tensor A}=iota_n(1_A). Hence B_{P_n,Q_n}=iota_n(B_{P,Q}). This calculation preserves the displayed parentheses and uses no associativity.
